processSection.subtitle: Four steps, with a report every month.

steps.title: Check-up and plan (first two weeks)
steps.description: We look at where you rank, what competitors do better and what's broken, then agree a plan.

steps.title: Fix the basics (first month)
steps.description: We repair broken pages, speed up the site and make it easy for Google to read.

steps.title: Add and improve content (every month)
steps.description: We improve your key pages and publish new articles.

steps.title: Build trust and report (every month)
steps.description: We earn links from other websites and send a monthly report on rankings and visitors.

faqSection.heading: Common questions
faqSection.subtitle: What people ask before starting SEO with us.

faqs.question: How long until I see results?
faqs.answer: Usually 3 to 6 months for clear movement, depending on your competition and your site's history. Unlike ads, the results keep working after you stop paying for each click.

faqs.question: Can you guarantee first place on Google?
faqs.answer: No one honest can, because Google changes how it ranks sites. We promise careful, approved methods and a clear monthly report on what moved.

faqs.question: Is writing included?
faqs.answer: On Full SEO, yes: four blog posts a month, written for you. On Local SEO we improve the words you already have.

faqs.question: What's the difference between Local and Full SEO?
faqs.answer: Local SEO is for businesses serving one area, like a plumber serving one town, and focuses on Google Maps and local listings. Full SEO is for reaching customers across the country or abroad, with articles and links from other websites.

faqs.question: Can you handle a large website or online shop?
faqs.answer: Yes. Custom SEO is planned in phases, each with a fixed price and a report.
